 Thursday's special edition of NSN Tonight was taped at Mackay Stadium ahead of the Nevada football team’s home game against No. 22 New Mexico at 6 p.m. Friday night. The hour-long show includes interviews with Wolf Pack head coach Jeff Choate and assistant coach Joey Thomas Jr.; a feature on Wolf Pack tight end Carter Eck; and a preview of the Nevada-New Mexico game with three keys to victory and a prediction. You can watch the full show below.
